messages.subject: time serious plots
parts:
hey my fellows.

i am joining four plots in the same area using grid.layout like below

grid.newpage()
pushViewport(viewport(layout = grid.layout(2, 2)))
vplayout <- function(x, y)
viewport(layout.pos.row = x, layout.pos.col = y)
print(pg1, vp = vplayout(1, 1))
print(pg2, vp = vplayout(2, 1))
print(pg3, vp = vplayout(1, 2))
print(pg4, vp = vplayout(2, 2))


but i don't know how to give them a common title for all the plots?
does the mtext ( ) works in ggplot2 or any possible solution?

messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Re: time serious plots
parts:
mtext is for base graphics - you'll need to use grid.text for ggplot2 graphics.
Hadley
